name: aimony-erp
description: Connect Codex to AIMony ERP with guided sign-in, permission-scoped dynamic discovery, revocable standing approvals, governed finance actions and live invoice presentations, strategy, settings, and blog publishing.

interface.shortDescription: Run AIMony ERP tasks safely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to AIMony ERP with native sign-in, a compact permission-scoped dynamic capability catalog, disjoint effect lanes, exact confirmations, actor/workspace/source-bound revocable standing approvals, replay-safe finance and domain actions, current visual invoice and proforma presentations, typed strategy records, managed settings, and scheduled blog publishing.
defaultPrompt: فضای کاری فعال AIMony من را شناسایی و خلاصه کن.
تعداد و فهرست مشتریان، محصولات، تیکت‌ها و فاکتورهای این workspace را کامل بررسی کن.
این عملیات ERP را پیشنهاد بده و بعد از تأیید صریح من از همین‌جا نهایی کن.
